questions.text: Describe a time when you got up very early.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a time when you got up very early. You should say: when it was; why you got up so early; what you did that day; and explain how you felt about getting up early.

questions.text: Do you usually get up early at the weekend too?
questions.say: Thank you. Do you usually get up early at the weekend too?

questions.text: Is it better to get up early or to stay up late?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a time when you got up very early, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all daily routines. Is it better to get up early or to stay up late?

questions.text: Why is it important for children to have a regular routine?
questions.say: Why is it important for children to have a regular routine?

questions.text: How have people's daily routines changed in recent years?
questions.say: How have people's daily routines changed in recent years?

questions.text: Should people be allowed to choose their own working hours?
questions.say: Now let's talk about working hours. Should people be allowed to choose their own working hours?

questions.text: Why do some people have to work at night?

questions.text: Do you think a four-day working week is a good idea?
